newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian Oil $200 mln loan oversubscribed - Citibank.
newsitem.headline: Indian Oil $200 mln loan oversubscribed - Citibank.

text.p: Citibank International Plc said on Friday a $200 million syndicated foreign currency loan facility for Indian Oil Corp Ltd was oversubscribed.
The loan was structured at 20 basis points above LIBOR with a multiple drawdown facility in the form of 180-day advances during the availability period of 60 days.
The loan facility is to be used to finance imports of crude oil and petroleum products.
Citibank said the facility, which was signed on December 16, was oversubscribed but not increased.

Banks joining the syndicated loan included Banca Monte dei Paschi di Siena SpA, Banco Central Hispanoamericano S.A., Banco Espanol de Credito S.A., Banque Bruxelles Lambert S.A., BW Bank Ireland plc, Citibank N.A.,Credit Communal de Belgique S.A., The Fuji Bank Limited, Gulf International Bank B.S.C., Landesbank Rheinland-Pfaz, Mitsui Trust Bank (Europe) S.A., Nord/LB Norddeutsche Landesbank Girozentrale, The Royal Bank of Scotland plc, SBI European Bank plc, The Tokai Bank Limited and Yaimichi Bank (U.K.) plc.
